messages:
maya: Heads up — after the rollout at 09:10 we started seeing console chart renders spike. p95 chart paint up ~2.6x and CPU jumps on the renderer. Noticed a bunch of bundle-chunk fetches stalling.
sam: Which rollout? the routing policy change for metrics->dedicated? :thinking_face:
maya: yeah that one. Canary at 30% this morning. deploy-bot: canary 30% -> success. infra-ci-bot: build 2026.03.20.914 completed.
jess: I dug into telemetry — large increase in kvcache miss rate for heatmap tiles right after canary. baseline miss ~8% -> 38%.
kevin: suspicious. that routing change also altered the CDN origin header we send, right? Could be bypassing our edge cache and hitting the origin in another region.
ethan: confirmed: requests for /heatmap/tiles are getting routed to eu-west-2 while user's req hits us in us-west-1. extra ~140ms per tile. Combine that with heavy hydration -> visible chart stutter.
maya: attaching a quick waterfall dump (first-party stack trimmed):
```
GET /static/chunk-visual-7.js 200 42ms
GET /heatmap/tiles?key=abc  200 12ms
GET /heatmap/tiles?key=def  200 156ms  <-- cross-region
GET /static/chart-runtime-2.js 200 5ms
XHR /api/console/kvcache/check  200 22ms
render: start 14:32:11.023
render: paint delay due to tile wait 156ms
```
sam: That tile 156ms lines up with the p95 jump. Any change to prefetch priority or chunk-parallelism in the deploy? maya: we switched the default prefetch budget lower in the new runtime to reduce bursts, but should not cause cross-region misses.
jess: I also saw bundle size for chunk-visual-7 increased by ~70KB after a tree-shake tweak. Not huge but it nudges critical path. However the real cost is the tile latency + KV cache churn.
kevin: quick mitigation options: 1) revert routing header tweak so edge cache hits again, 2) temporarily raise prefetch budget for charts, or 3) route chart tile requests to nearest origin using sticky-region override.
ethan: option 1 is fastest. I can push a hotfix to canary to flip header back. That should restore edge behavior immediately.
maya: +1 to hotfix, but we should also add a telemetry flag to track origin-region vs client-region mismatch. jess: on it — I'll add a delta metric tag (origin_region != client_region) and a KV miss correlation tag.
deploy-bot: starting hotfix deploy -> canary 30% (flip origin header) :rocket:
infra-ci-bot: hotfix build 2026.03.20.923 green.
sam: After hotfix, let's watch p95 and kvcache miss for 20m before promoting. Also create an on-call pager if it doesn't drop.
maya: agreed. logging note: include request header X-Region-Routed and log the selected origin id for better postmortem.
kevin: long-term: we need a routing policy test harness that simulates cache behavior across regions before rolling. This slipped because tests only validated functional routing not cache affinity.
ethan: can add e2e test that runs in staging and asserts edge hit ratio > 95% for chart tiles.
jess: already started a small dashboard for this metric in Console Observability, will share a link when ready.
maya: thanks team. keep updates in this thread. :eyes:
